verses.text: A song by David for going up to worship. See how good and pleasant it is when brothers and sisters live together in harmony!
It is like fine, scented oil on the head, running down the beard—down Aaron’s beard— running over the collar of his robes.
It is like dew on Mount Hermon, dew which comes down on Zion’s mountains. That is where the Lord promised the blessing of eternal life.
